definitions.gloss: insect bite; insect sting; bug bite
definitions.explanation: A bite or sting from an insect such as a mosquito, flea, or bee, or the resulting skin irritation.

examples.japanese: {虫刺|むしさ}され⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧。
{虫刺|むしさ}され⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied medicine to the insect bite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{虫刺|むしさ}され⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{虫除|むしよ}け→虫除け：09715_mushiyoke⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In summer, insect bites get bad when camping, so bug repellent spray is essential.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (insect) and ⟦{刺|さ}される→刺す：02111_sasu⟧ (to be stung/bitten), forming a compound noun. Refers to any kind of insect bite or sting, most commonly mosquito bites in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虫刺|むしさ}され⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: insect bite medication
- {虫刺|むしさ}され⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: insect bite mark
- {虫刺|むしさ}され⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掻|か}く→掻く：09647_kaku⟧: to scratch an insect bite
- {虫刺|むしさ}され⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れる→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧: an insect bite swells up
